text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My first three years in the Twinkle Series
with Kitasan Black came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Along with her running, her passionate Winning Live performances gained recognition, until finally—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Performing on a prime-time music show!
It feels like a dream!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's not a dream. This is all thanks to the support
of the hardcore live fans. And also...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It is the fruit of Kita-chan's hard work and singing talent.
Let us give it our all together today, yay~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right on, zo-yo~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Right, practice. First, some vocal warm-ups!
Let's see..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Today's Goddess of Victory belongs to
me and me aloooone~~~!"
choice_data_list: That vibrato! Way too much vibrato!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I messed up again! Thank you very much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. Cute, stay cute...
We are pop Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Umadacchi!
Ooh, Umapyoi, Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Kitasan Black bounded energetically on stage. Her performance was a huge hit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You did it, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was great, Kita-chan!
Wasn't that your best one yet?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm practicing hard for the live performance too.
I want everyone to have the best time possible.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today was a unit performance,
but keep up this momentum and do your best singing too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Someday... I hope they'll invite me to sing a solo enka song—!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-chan.
There's one thing I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it, Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Umapyoi.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Umapyoi. We are Umapyoi.
Whenever we appear on TV, that is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? I mean, I love Umapyoi of course,
but it's fine if we perform a different song, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I love Teio-san's
"Koi wa Derby☆" and all that too,
so of course I want to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But we're Umapyoi, you know.
First and foremost.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Someone told me a long time ago. Back on the day I first stood on the same stage as the President I so admired...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me, Teio. Races are important
to an Umamusume, of course. But...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live is just as important a place of self-expression for an Umamusume.
I hope you won't forget that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A place for self-expression...?
What am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I always want you to strive for a stage
that only an Umamusume could create.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A performance making full use of running and jumping abilities.
And—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Conveying the brightness and joy of Umamusume.
That's what 'Umapyoi Densetsu' is able to do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First off, don't you want
as many people as possible to know this song?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... Brightness and fun...
That's very true.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then first, I'm gonna master Umapyoi Densetsu!
Even before enka!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right. Let's go with that mindset!
First comes Umapyoi, second comes Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Skip 3 and 4, straight to Umapyoi on 5!
Come on, Trainer, let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Let's spread Umapyoi together,
everyone. And then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the big music shows, right?
Alright, here we go! Ready, set!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Teio
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the singing talent she inherited changes shape,
exploding onto the stage again today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's Umapyoi just kept getting more and more polished.
The day she gets to debut her Enka—
seems to still be a long way off.
